other_conditions: Unit must be registered with NSIC under the Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS) or must apply for registration under SPRS.
The unit’s factory must be inspected before filing a tender under the Tender Marketing Scheme.
Units engaged solely in trading activities without value addition, packing or branding are not eligible.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro & Small Enterprises
benefits_summary: Enlists the unit for participation in government and private tenders, with a reduced service charge of 0.5% for consortium members.
